Ministry of Education, Science, Vocational Training and Early Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Agricultural Science Syllabus, Grades 10-12' (2013, published by CDC, ISBN 9982-00-548-X) — Grade 11, Topics 11.1-11.9. Genuine gap fill, part of the same real syllabus as this app's new Grade 10 and Grade 12 Agricultural Science files; this app previously had no OBC Grade 10-12 Agricultural Science content at all. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; Content (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns omitted, consistent with every other bundled OBC subject in this app.

STRUCTURAL TERM SPLIT (not sourced, same convention as this app's Biology Grade 10-12 files): the 9 real topics are divided into three equal groups of 3 topics each, in original curriculum order (11.1-11.3, 11.4-11.6, 11.7-11.9), labelled 'Term 1'/'Term 2'/'Term 3' purely so the app can generate and share one term at a time. No topic, sub-topic, or competency was added, removed, or altered.

Real irregularity documented, not silently corrected: under sub-topic '11.3.5 Pests and Diseases of Crops', the raw source table numbers its outcomes '11.3.5.1', then jumps to '11.3.14' and '11.3.15' for the next two outcomes (a real printed numbering slip, almost certainly meant to read 11.3.5.2/11.3.5.3, but reproduced here only as the plain outcome text — this file does not encode source numbering codes at all, only outcome descriptions, so the slip has no visible effect on the file's own content beyond this disclosure). No individual person's name is cited in this note, consistent with how this app cites every other CDC syllabus.
